content.value: A capacitive transducer uses two quartz diaphragms of area $7 5 0 ~ \mathrm { \ m m } ^ { 2 }$ separated by a distance of 3.5 mm. A pressure of 900 $\mathrm { k N } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$ when applied to the top diaphragm produces a deflection of 0.6 mm. The capacitance is 370 pF when no pressure is applied to the diaphragms. Find the value of capacitance after the application of a pressure of 900 $\mathrm { k N } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
